title: World conforms to CALL-02 B2/B3 on a real F2+ run: triage kept, docs independent
outcome: On real world records, taint matches the frozen hero story: triage untainted (kept without redo), docs and inventory independent
acceptance: tests/taint/test_world_f2plus.py::test_world_triage_kept passes with its strict xfail removed (triage's view no longer delivers a tainted version when it edits S-17's risk_note)
test_world_docs_independent passes with its strict xfail removed (docs does not read reporter's tainted RPT docs, per the B3 independent lane)
ks.inject tests (T2 pre-fault byte-identical to S*, hero guard, F2+c/F2+x) and tests/world stay green
summary: Review follow-up: renamed test_triage_view_excludes_iban -> test_triage_view_has_no_suppliers (tests/world/test_world.py); added 'suppliers:S-17.iban not in read_set' assertion to test_world_triage_reads_s17_row_untainted (tests/taint/test_world_f2plus.py). Suite 692 passed, 8 skipped. ADR-06 amendment left to ADR owner per review (b).
review:
[maya · changes] Code accepted; suite green (631 passed, 8 skipped). (a) B2 stays honest: triage edits S-17 with no iban in its view (now no supplier rows at all), and the field-object rule (B3-04) is still shown on the real world, more strongly than before, by the recorded adapter read: test_world.py asserts triage's h+2 read_set has no suppliers:S-17.iban, and test_world_triage_reads_s17_row_untainted asserts the S-17 row read is recorded and untainted. The view-level test has lost its iban purpose: rename it test_triage_view_has_no_suppliers, and add an explicit 'suppliers:S-17.iban not in read_set' to the taint world test so the field-object claim is pinned where taint is computed. (b) The reports: table is accepted: it makes CALL-02 B3's independent docs lane true with no accounting change. Required, because ADRs are binding and must not silently diverge: amend ADR-06 World para ('Triage's view lists suppliers:S-17, not .iban' -> tickets only; S-17 row read via the adapter, recorded, without .iban) and the Dependencies line (reporter writes reports:RPT-*, outside docs' scope). The demo line in B3 still holds. (c) Not weakened: the strict xfails now pass as plain tests, and the replaced s22-only cause test asserted a bug that no longer exists. Note: the GatewayTxn/visible_to edits in tools.py are not part of this issue.

[maya · done] All items verified. (a) Renamed to test_triage_view_has_no_suppliers (asserts no suppliers: rows in triage's view; billing still sees S-17.iban); test_world_triage_reads_s17_row_untainted now also asserts suppliers:S-17.iban not in triage's read_set, so the field-object rule is pinned where taint is computed. (b) ADR-06 World para and Dependencies line amended to match the code (tickets-only view, adapter S-17 row read without .iban, reports:RPT-* outside docs' scope). (c) No strict xfails left in test_world_f2plus.py. tests/world+taint+inject green; full suite 692 passed, 8 skipped.
